title: Python Mastery: From Fundamentals to Advanced

python-basic-to-advanced-complete-master.title: Python Basic to Advanced: Complete Mastery Roadmap
python-basic-to-advanced-complete-master.description: A phase roadmap that takes you from Python basics to professional-level development. Each phase has the concepts to learn and a ready-to-use Mastery Prompt, covering OOP, async, testing, internals, architecture and interview prep.

phase-01-python-environment-and-first-pr.title: Phase 01 — Python Environment & First Programs.
phase-01-python-environment-and-first-pr.description: Python Environment & First Programs: what Python is, how CPython runs code, installation, versions, the REPL, running scripts, indentation, comments, statements vs expressions, print() and input().
